title: Multi-factor mediated functional modules identify novel classification of ulcerative colitis and functional gene panel.
authors: Lai, Lijie; Li, Hanyang; Feng, Qi; Shen, Jun; Ran, Zhihua
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过共表达网络和转录因子-基因调控预测对溃疡性结肠炎进行分子分型，但仅涉及TF-靶基因调控关系推断，无TF-DNA结合位点预测、三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: Ulcerative colitis is a chronic, idiopathic, and inflammatory disease of the rectal and colonic mucosa, the behavior of which is of heterogeneity in individuals. Here, we explored the multifactor-mediated functional modules associated with ulcerative colitis classification in the whole genome. Datasets downloaded from the GEO database were used to identify differentially expressed genes between ulcerative colitis patients and healthy individuals initially, followed by acquisition of the remaining ulcerative colitis -related genes from the OMIM and STRING databases. The results identified 914 ulcerative colitis-related genes, of which 60 were differentially expressed genes obtained from GEO datasets. Through weighted co-expression network analysis of ulcerative colitis-related genes, four modules were obtained, three of which were related to ulcerative colitis. Following interactions between microRNA, long noncoding RNA, transcription factors, and module hub genes were predicted and used to construct ulcerative colitis multifactor networks. Additionally, we performed consensus clustering of the ulcerative colitis samples. The results revealed that ulcerative colitis could be divided into four subtypes, with six hub genes identified as potential biomarkers for classification. These findings offer novel insights into ulcerative colitis and a basis for disease classification of ulcerative colitis.
abstract_zh: 溃疡性结肠炎是一种慢性、特发性、炎症性的直肠和结肠黏膜疾病，其行为在个体间具有异质性。在此，我们探索了全基因组范围内与溃疡性结肠炎分类相关的多因子介导的功能模块。从GEO数据库下载的数据集最初用于识别溃疡性结肠炎患者与健康个体之间的差异表达基因，随后从OMIM和STRING数据库获取剩余的溃疡性结肠炎相关基因。结果识别出914个溃疡性结肠炎相关基因，其中60个是从GEO数据集获得的差异表达基因。通过对溃疡性结肠炎相关基因进行加权共表达网络分析，获得了四个模块，其中三个与溃疡性结肠炎相关。随后预测了microRNA、长链非编码RNA、转录因子与模块中心基因之间的相互作用，并用于构建溃疡性结肠炎多因子网络。此外，我们对溃疡性结肠炎样本进行了共识聚类分析。结果显示，溃疡性结肠炎可分为四个亚型，并识别出六个中心基因作为分类的潜在生物标志物。这些发现为溃疡性结肠炎提供了新的见解，并为溃疡性结肠炎的疾病分类奠定了基础。
